reason: I might download the free app, but three free questions a day is already more than I need for a 10-minute omelet, and I can learn kra pao free from the clips I watch every night. I don't pay monthly for things, and 99 baht a month is two dinners of basil pork.
objection: Why pay every month just for unlimited questions when the free version gives me three a day and there are only two dishes? A subscription keeps taking money even in weeks I don't cook, and with my tiny kitchen and one pan I only make a few simple things anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A lot more cheap one-pan dishes made for a tiny kitchen, so it clearly saves me more on food each month than it costs.
